title: Auslander Conjecture on Affine Crystallographic Groups
exact_target: Are groups acting properly and cocompactly by affine transformations always virtually solvable, with the corresponding compact complete manifold groups virtually polycyclic?

sources.citation: William M. Goldman, "Geometric Structures on Manifolds," AMS Graduate Studies in Mathematics 227 (2022), Conjecture 8.6.2; cf. H. Abels, G. Margulis, G. Soifer, arXiv:2011.12788 (Auslander conjecture for n < 7).
